description: List the bots in your workspace that have digital (chat) compliance runs: one row per targetRef with lastRunAt, runCount and the compliance catalogue test ids that have run against it. Takes no parameters. Use when: the user asks which chat bots have been audited for compliance. For one bot's report use getDigitalComplianceAudit with its targetRef. Voice compliance is listComplianceReports. Read-only. Needs digital:read.
name: listDigitalComplianceAudits
title: List Digital Compliance Audits
